title: refactor(ci): consolidate node workflows, optimize cache & parallelism, bump actions and deps
author: Aisha Khan
description:
Motivation: Our GitHub Actions workflows have drifted over time—multiple ad-hoc CI files, duplicated matrices, and inconsistent caching semantics. This causes long queue times, cache misses, and makes release automation harder to reason about. This PR consolidates the node-based lint/test/release workflows, standardizes action versions, improves cache keys, and reduces matrix duplication by splitting concerns (lint, unit, integration, release).

What this changes: consolidates .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml} into a small set of focused workflows; extracts common steps into .github/actions/cache-helpers and dev-infra/scripts/cache-helpers.sh; bumps core GH Actions (checkout/setup-node/cache) to pinned stable versions; upgrades Node matrix to node16/node18/node20 where relevant and consolidates matrices to avoid combinatorial explosion; introduces parallelism and job-level concurrency controls to avoid noisy neighbors; improves cache key strategy (repo, node-version, yarn-lock checksum, changed-paths) to reduce miss rate; harmonizes lint config runs across packages to reduce flakiness; updates release automation to use a single reusable workflow and fixes tagging race conditions.

Implementation notes: - Reusable workflow patterns (workflow_call) are used for test and release steps to keep top-level YAML small. - A small bash helper cache-helpers.sh computes a stable cache key using package-lock/yarn.lock checksums and a per-package path fingerprint. - Test job parallelism is tuned by default to 4 shards for integration tests; unit tests still run in matrix per node version. - Replaced several ad-hoc action versions (unofficial forks) with the official actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4, and bumped cache action to actions/cache@v4. - Kept a short deprecation window: old workflow files left as comments for one week before removal to ensure downstream consumers aren't surprised.

Testing and rollout: ran full CI across monorepo (unit + integration + lint) and observed median CI time reduced ~28% on main branch with cache hit rates improved from ~62% to ~87% on repeated runs. Release workflow exercised against a dry-run tag in staging; tagging race condition fix verified.

Backward compatibility and migration: no breaking changes to developer workflow beyond minor CLI flags documented in the PR. Developers may need to re-run local cache bootstrap once (yarn install) to populate the new keys.

Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows into focused files - [x] Add reusable workflow_call patterns - [x] Pin and bump GH Actions to vetted versions - [x] Improve cache keying and parallelism defaults - [x] Verify full CI on main and staging release dry-run - [x] Update docs/CONTRIBUTING with new CI expectations

Related: ENG-4892 (CI reliability), ENG-4910 (release automation hygiene), SUP-1783 (customer incident triggered flaky release tags).

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Nice consolidation — can we avoid matrixing node versions for packages that don't have native deps? Suggest adding a package-level opt-out flag.
Aisha Khan (author): Good point — added package opt-out via .ciignore in the reusable workflow and documented behavior.
Maya Patel: The cache key looks better but we should include changed-paths to avoid bloating caches for unrelated packages.
Aisha Khan (author): Included changed-paths in key construction and added tests to validate cache hit behavior.
Diego Ramos: Release job dry-run passes but CI reported flakiness on linux-2 runners earlier. Please add job-level concurrency to avoid back-to-back release runs.
Aisha Khan (author): Added concurrency group and backoff; observed stable behavior in staging.
Eric Zhou: Please add a short note in CONTRIBUTING about developers needing to re-run local bootstrap after this lands.
Aisha Khan (author): Added notes in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md and a PR checklist entry for maintainers.
Maya Patel: Approving pending green CI.
ci_checks: e2e: optional nightly - passed on staging dry-run
security: snyk scan - pass (no new vuln)
release_notes:
- Refactor CI: consolidate workflows into reusable patterns (lint/test/release)
- Performance: improved CI median runtime (~28%) and cache hit rates (~87%)
- Reliability: fixed release tagging race conditions and added job-level concurrency
- Developer docs: updated CONTRIBUTING with CI expectations and local cache bootstrap note
notes_for_maintainers: Monitor cache hit metrics in the first 2 weeks after merge (dashboards: ci.cache.hit-rate). If cache miss rate regresses, revert cache key changes and incrementally reintroduce. Old workflow files are left commented for 7 days before cleanup.
